_comment: Hits from scripts/i18n-contamination.mjs that a human read and judged correct as written.
A legitimate hit is rare and has a reason that can be stated: a language or place name written
in its own script, a quoted sample of another writing system. The default answer to a hit is
to retranslate the string in the locale's own script, not to record it here.
An entry is keyed by locale, key AND value (joined by U+001F), so rewording a string retires its
acceptance. An entry that no longer matches any hit is stale and fails the gate: delete it.
Never bulk-accept. Every line here is read against the language, not against the tool.
